label: КНСБ: 1 516 евро нетен месечен доход за тричленно семейство (21 ноември)
text: The trade union's subsistence calculation puts a two-earner family with one child under 14 at €1,516 net a month, up €92 in a year, with €842 for a single working person and a required gross wage of €1,085 — below which sit about 1.5m insured persons, or 57.7% of those observed. Violeta Ivanova of КНСБ said the budget's 5% public-sector rise will not offset energy and fuel prices and demanded at least 10% for 2027 in both sectors. NSS background for the same day: food 29.3% of household spending in 2025, housing 15.4%, transport and communications 11.1%, 42.5% of people unable to cover an unexpected expense, and an average gross monthly wage of €1,438 in Q3 2026 (+10.4% year on year).
